span.p:
Signals emitted:
• on_phase_change(SHOWDOWN)
• on_pot_change (per side pot)
• on_player_action (each award)
• on_pot_collection_required(winner_seat)
Also emitted on FOLD-out:
• on_pot_collection_required(winner_seat)
Validation errors emit:
• on_action_rejected(reason)
